column5: Complementary activities to the expanded programme of work on forest biodiversity9
column6: 森林生物多樣性擴大工作計畫之補充活動9

column5: 1. [Protect and] conserve forests, [in particular primary [and high-integrity] forests] through participatory and biodiversity-inclusive spatial planning practices, to enhance ecological integrity and forest connectivity[, respecting and protecting human rights, including those of indigenous peoples and local communities]. 2. Identify, disseminate and apply best practices [and principles] for forest restoration, including for qualitative aspects of forest management, with regard to spatial and within-stand heterogeneity, connectivity, climate adaptation and resilience, climate projections, wildfire management and decreasing risks of other biotic and abiotic disturbances. 3. Consider other effective area-based conservation measures as an integral part of forest landscape planning to improve forest connectivity, including in areas managed by indigenous peoples and local communities. 4. Encourage the use of native species in reforestation. [5. Promote guidelines, mechanisms and indicators for forest restoration monitoring and evaluation.]
column6: 1. [保護及] 保育森林，[特別是原生 [及高完整性] 森林]，透過參與式且具生物多樣性包容性之空間規劃做法，以增進生態完整性與森林連結性[，並尊重及保護人權，包括原住民族與地方社區之人權]。2. 識別、傳播並應用森林復育之最佳做法 [與原則]，包括森林管理之品質面向，涉及空間與林分內異質性、連結性、氣候調適與韌性、氣候推估、野火管理，以及降低其他生物與非生物干擾之風險。3. 將保育共生地視為森林景觀規劃之組成部分，以改善森林連結性，包括在由原住民族與地方社區管理之區域。4. 鼓勵在造林中使用原生種。[5. 推動森林復育監測與評估之指引、機制與指標。]

column5: 6. Manage human-wildlife conflict, including through sustainable forest management, where possible, while recognizing and respecting the rights of indigenous peoples and local communities and protecting and encouraging their customary sustainable use. 7. Identify, raise awareness of and promote the application of best practices for conserving and managing forest habitats, maintaining the genetic diversity of forest wild species and their habitats [to prevent and mitigate disease risks to people, reduce extinction risk and support the recovery and conservation of forest species]. 8. Combat illegal logging and trade[ and step up actions against deforestation and forest degradation]. 9. Identify ways and means to prevent trade in wild species, including invasive alien species, that has a negative impact on forest biodiversity. 10. Promote the development of forest timber and non-timber products to support sustainable livelihoods.
column6: 6. 在可能情況下，包括透過永續森林管理，管理人類與野生動物衝突，同時認可並尊重原住民族與地方社區之權利，並保護及鼓勵其慣習永續利用。7. 識別、提高對並推動應用森林棲地保育與管理之最佳做法，以維持森林野生物種及其棲地之遺傳多樣性 [以預防並減輕對人類之疾病風險、降低滅絕風險，並支持森林物種之復育與保育]。8. 打擊非法伐木與貿易[，並加強打擊森林砍伐與森林退化之行動]。9. 識別防止對森林生物多樣性有負面影響之野生物種（包括外來入侵種）貿易之方法與手段。10. 推動森林木材與非木材產品之開發，以支持永續生計。

column5: 11. Taking cross-cutting work on invasive alien species into account, provide guidance to assist forest practitioners and managers with preventing the introduction of invasive alien species, [and eradicating or controlling existing populations of such species,] including those that may be unintentionally spread through earth-moving and forest machinery and operations. 12. Promote the use of native species in forest restoration and management to prevent the introduction of invasive alien species.
column6: 11. 考量外來入侵種之跨領域工作，提供指引以協助森林從業者與管理者預防外來入侵種之引入，[並根除或控制此類物種之現有族群]，包括可能因土方工程與森林機械及作業而無意間傳播者。12. 推動在森林復育與管理中使用原生種，以防止外來入侵種之引入。

column5: [13. Taking the programme of work on agricultural biodiversity and the Global Action Plan on Biodiversity and Health10 into account, reduce soil loss and the risk posed by pesticides to forest biodiversity and human health.] 14. Increase understanding of the complex relationships between forest biodiversity and nutrient cycles and other biogeochemical flows, including atmospheric aerosols.
column6: [13. 考量農業生物多樣性工作計畫與生物多樣性與健康全球行動計畫，10 減少土壤流失以及農藥對森林生物多樣性與人類健康造成之風險。] 14. 增進對森林生物多樣性與養分循環及其他生物地球化學流動（包括大氣氣膠）之間複雜關係之理解。

column5: [15. Encourage the development and evaluation of options for the adoption of biopesticides and lower-risk pest control products and approaches in forest ecosystems.]
column6: [15. 鼓勵開發與評估在森林生態系中採用生物農藥及較低風險之害蟲防治產品與方法之選項。]

column5: 16. Enhance the benefits for biodiversity, and avoid the negative impacts, of carbon market-driven incentives for large-scale restoration, including through afforestation. 17. Increase understanding of the impacts of climate change on forest biodiversity and on long-term forest management. 18. Enhance forest ecosystem integrity and resilience, as an approach to climate change mitigation and adaptation and disaster risk reduction, by using nature-based solutions and/or ecosystem-based approaches, considering likely long-term ecosystem changes and environmental and social safeguards. 19. Restore, maintain and enhance forest ecosystem functions and services, such as climate regulation, carbon sequestration, water regulation, good water quality, soil health, pollination and cultural values, through sustainable forest management, nature-based solutions and/or ecosystem-based approaches.
column6: 16. 提高碳市場驅動之大規模復育（包括透過造林）誘因對生物多樣性之效益，並避免其負面影響。17. 增進對氣候變遷對森林生物多樣性及長期森林管理影響之理解。18. 透過使用以自然為本的解決方案及／或以生態系為本的方法，並考量可能的長期生態系變化以及環境與社會保障措施，強化森林生態系之完整性與韌性，作為減緩與調適氣候變遷及降低災害風險之方法。19. 透過永續森林管理、以自然為本的解決方案及／或以生態系為本的方法，復育、維持並強化森林生態系功能與服務，例如氣候調節、碳封存、水調節、良好水質、土壤健康、授粉及文化價值。

column5: 20. Further develop, promote and implement [biodiversity-friendly practices], including closer-to-nature forest management, sustainable forest management, the implementation of safeguards into reforestation measures, reduced-impact logging practices, the conservation of areas of particular importance to biodiversity, sustainable intensification, agroecology, agroforestry and inter-cropping, to reduce forest fragmentation and integrate indigenous knowledge and practices, as appropriate. 21. Promote approaches that improve the socioeconomic conditions of indigenous peoples and local communities, including alternative livelihoods based on the conservation, restoration and sustainable use of forest resources. 22. Promote sustainable forest management and the sustainable use of forest products by all relevant stakeholders, including indigenous peoples and local communities. 23. Support innovative business models that contribute to the conservation, sustainable use and restoration of forest biodiversity[, [including in the context][through the development and promotion] of bioeconomy programmes and policies]. 24. Promote the evidence-based sustainable use of fungal biodiversity for sustainable forest management.
column6: 20. 進一步發展、推廣並實施 [生物多樣性友善做法]，包括更貼近自然的森林管理、永續森林管理、在造林措施中落實保障措施、低衝擊伐木做法、保育對生物多樣性特別重要之區域、永續集約化、農業生態、農林複合經營及間作，以減少森林破碎化，並在適當情況下整合原住民族知識與做法。21. 推廣能改善原住民族與地方社區社會經濟條件之方法，包括基於森林資源保育、復育與永續利用之替代生計。22. 推廣所有相關利害關係人（包括原住民族與地方社區）進行永續森林管理及森林產品之永續利用。23. 支持有助於森林生物多樣性保育、永續利用與復育之創新商業模式[，[包括在……脈絡下][透過開發與推廣] 生物經濟方案與政策]。24. 推廣以實證為基礎之真菌生物多樣性永續利用，以促進永續森林管理。

column5: 25. Provide and apply the principles of urban forestry and urban green space planning to urban development.
column6: 25. 將都市林業與都市綠地規劃之原則提供並應用於都市發展。

column5: 26. Strengthen cross-sectoral efforts and mainstream forest biodiversity into policies, strategies and measures, including national forest strategies. 27. Promote the application of the System of Environmental-Economic Accounting, as appropriate, to recognize the contributions of forest ecosystem services and functions to the economy and the environment.
column6: 26. 強化跨部門努力，並將森林生物多樣性主流化至政策、策略與措施，包括國家森林策略。27. 在適當情況下，推廣應用環境經濟會計系統，以認可森林生態系服務與功能對經濟與環境之貢獻。

column5: 28. Promote good practices [in non-forest industries] in the production and supply chains to address the risk of deforestation, taking national legislation and socioeconomic conditions into account. [29. Encourage and support business and financial institutions to monitor, assess and transparently disclose forest biodiversity-related risks in their sustainability reporting.]
column6: 28. 推廣 [非森林產業在] 生產與供應鏈中之良好做法，以因應森林砍伐風險，並考量國家立法與社會經濟條件。[29. 鼓勵並支持企業與金融機構在其永續報告中監測、評估並透明揭露與森林生物多樣性相關之風險。]

column5: [30. Encourage and support consumers[, in line with national laws and policies,] to make informed decisions and buy from legal and sustainable supply chains by providing relevant information.] 31. Address obstacles to sustainable forest management, such as the lack of market access for value-added forest products originating from sustainably managed forests.
column6: [30. 鼓勵並支持消費者[，依據國家法律與政策，]透過提供相關資訊做出知情決定，並自合法且永續之供應鏈購買。] 31. 處理永續森林管理之障礙，例如源自永續管理森林之高附加價值森林產品缺乏市場進入機會。

column5: 32. Strengthen, further develop and promote financing instruments for the conservation, restoration and sustainable use of forest. 33. Eliminate, phase out or reform subsidies harmful to forest biodiversity. 34. Engage the private sector in the development of innovative financial instruments or mechanisms to support forest conservation and restoration and sustainable forest management, such as payments for ecosystem services. 35. Work closely with the Global Forest Financing Facilitation Network of the United Nations Forum on Forests, ensuring equal access to finance for all eligible Parties. [36. Improve equitable access and employ adequate financing instruments to enhance the role of indigenous peoples and local communities in implementing forest governance and community-based forest management.]
column6: 32. 強化、進一步發展並促進用於森林保育、復育與永續利用之融資工具。33. 消除、逐步淘汰或改革對森林生物多樣性有害之補貼。34. 使私部門參與開發創新融資工具或機制（例如生態系服務給付），以支持森林保育、復育及永續森林管理。35. 與聯合國森林論壇之全球森林融資促進網路密切合作，確保所有符合資格之締約方皆能平等取得資金。[36. 改善公平取得資金之情形並運用適足之融資工具，以強化原住民族與地方社區在落實森林治理及以社區為基礎之森林管理中的角色。]

column5: 37. Enhance technical and scientific cooperation, technology transfer and capacity-building to add greater value to forest products, in a manner supportive of enterprises led by forest-dependent communities, including businesses led by indigenous peoples and local communities.
column6: 37. 強化技術與科學合作、技術移轉及能力建構，以提高森林產品之附加價值，其方式應支持由依賴森林之社區所主導之企業，包括由原住民族與地方社區所主導之企業。

column5: 38. Taking the programme of work on Article 8(j) and other provisions of the Convention on Biological Diversity11 related to indigenous peoples and local communities to 203012 and the Gender Plan of Action (2023–2030)13 into account: (a) Promote the understanding and application of indigenous and traditional knowledge, world views and values as they relate to forest and landscape management practices; [(b) Identify and promote best practices for the legal recognition of land and forest tenure of indigenous peoples and local communities;] (c) Identify and promote best practices [for access to information and justice and] for increasing participation in the planning and management of forests by indigenous peoples and local communities, women, youth, persons with disabilities and other relevant actors; [(d) Recognize gender roles, responsibilities, uses, rights and practices to address underlying social and gender inequalities and adopt a gender-responsive approach in forest conservation and restoration and sustainable forest management;] [(e) Ensure the full protection of environmental human rights defenders.]
column6: 38. 考量關於第 8(j) 條及《生物多樣性公約》11 其他與原住民族與地方社區相關規定至 2030 年之工作計畫，12 以及性別行動計畫（2023–2030），13 (a) 促進對與森林及景觀管理做法相關之原住民與傳統知識、世界觀及價值觀之理解與應用；[(b) 識別並促進對原住民族與地方社區土地及森林權屬給予法律認可之最佳做法；] (c) 識別並促進 [取得資訊與司法救濟，以及] 提高原住民族與地方社區、女性、青年、身心障礙者及其他相關行動者參與森林規劃與管理之最佳做法；[(d) 認可性別角色、責任、利用、權利與做法，以處理潛在的社會與性別不平等，並在森林保育與復育及永續森林管理中採取具性別回應之方法；] [(e) 確保對環境人權捍衛者提供充分保護。]
